data.name: Mekka
data.gender_notes: Mekka is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Mekka refers to the holiest city in Islam, where Muslims go on a pilgrimage called Hajj. The name Mekka carries the meaning “House of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mekka usually hope their child will grow to embody house of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of faith and devotion, representing the journey towards closeness to Allah.
data.etymology: Mekka belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “House of Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mekka total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: مكة
in_arabic.meaning: المدينة المقدسة في المملكة العربية السعودية
in_arabic.long_meaning: مكة هي مدينة مقدسة لدى المسلمين، تقع في غرب المملكة العربية السعودية، وهي مقر إمارة منطقة مكة المكرمة. تعتبر مكة من أقدس المدن الإسلامية، حيث يأتي إليها المسلمون لأداء مناسك الحج والعمرة. تأتي أهمية مكة من كونها مهد الرسالة النبوية المكرمة، ومن وجود الكعبة المشرفة التي تعتبر قبلة المسلمين في جميع أنحاء العالم.

in_urdu.name: مکہ
in_urdu.meaning: سعودی عرب کا شہر، حج و عمرہ کی مقدس جگہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: مکہ سعودی عرب کا ایک شہر ہے جو مسلم دنیا کے لئے بہت اہم ہے۔ یہ شہر حج و عمرہ کی مناسک ادا کرنے کے لئے دنیا بھر سے مسلموں کو اپنی طرف متوجہ کرتا ہے۔ مکہ کی اہمیت اس کی وجہ سے ہے کہ یہ شہر اسلامی تاریخ میں بہت اہم کردار رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر نبی محمد صلی اللہ علیہ و آلہ و سلم کی زندگی میں۔

in_hindi.name: मक्का
in_hindi.meaning: सऊदी अरब का पवित्र शहर, हज और उमराह का स्थल
in_hindi.long_meaning: मक्का सऊदी अरब का एक शहर है जो मुस्लिम समुदाय के लिए बहुत पवित्र माना जाता है। यह शहर हज और उमराह की यात्रा करने वाले मुसलमानों के लिए एक महत्वपूर्ण स्थल है। मक्का की महत्ता इस्लामिक इतिहास में इसकी भूमिका के कारण है, विशेष रूप से पैगंबर मुहम्मद के जीवन में।

in_pashto.name: مکه
in_pashto.meaning: سعودي عرب کې مقدس ښار، د حج او عمرې ځای
in_pashto.long_meaning: مکه د سعودي عرب يو ښار دی چې د مسلمانانو لپاره ډېر اهم دی. دا ښار د حج او عمرې د ادا کولو لپاره د نړۍ له بېلابېلو برخو څخه مسلمانان راجلبوي. مکې اهميت د دې له امله دی چې دا ښار په اسلامي تاريخ کې ډېر مهم رول لري، په ځانګړي ډول د پيغمبر محمد صلی الله عليه وسلم په ژوند کې.

in_english.name: Mekka
in_english.meaning: Sacred city in Saudi Arabia, destination for Hajj and Umrah
in_english.long_meaning: Mekka is a city in Saudi Arabia considered sacred by Muslims worldwide. It is a major pilgrimage site for Hajj and Umrah, attracting millions of Muslims. Etymologically, the name 'Mekka' is derived from the Arabic root 'makk', which means 'to congest' or 'to crowd', reflecting the city's historical significance as a crowded and bustling center of worship. The city holds immense spiritual significance in Islam, being the birthplace of Prophet Muhammad and the site of the Kaaba, the holiest site in Islam.

data.cultural_impact: Mekka is the birthplace of the Prophet Muhammad and the site of the Kaaba, the most sacred building in Islam. It is the city to which Muslims around the world turn during their daily prayers. Every year, millions of Muslims from all corners of the world make a pilgrimage, or Hajj, to Mekka as a symbol of their faith and solidarity with their fellow believers. This cultural significance extends beyond the Muslim community, as Mekka is considered a symbol of tolerance and peaceful coexistence in a diverse and complex world.
data.spiritual_significance: Mekka holds immense spiritual significance for Muslims as it is the direction to which they face when they prayer, the Qibla. The city is home to the Kaaba, which is believed to have been built by the Prophet Ibrahim and his son Ismail, and is considered as the house of God. Muslims believe that visiting Mekka and performing the Hajj pilgrimage is a commandment from God, and will earn them immense spiritual rewards and blessings. The spiritual connection to Mekka is part of the foundation of the Islamic faith and provides a deep sense of unity and meaning for Muslims around the world.

In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Mekka serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of house of allah.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Rushd (Averroes) wrote in his book, "The Distinction", that Mekka was the name of the city to which Abraham was driven out by Nimrod, the king of Babylon. Abraham then built the Kaaba as a tower to worship God and to be a symbol of unity for his people.
historical_references.context: This is a pre-Islamic reference to the name Mekka and its historical significance as a place of worship and unity for the ancient Semitic people.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Jubayr, an Andalusian traveler, described Mekka in his book, "The Travels of Ibn Jubayr". He mentioned that Mekka was the birthplace of Muhammad and the place where Islam originated. He also described the annual pilgrimage, the Hajj, to the Kaaba, which is the holiest site in Islam.
historical_references.context: This reference to Mekka in the context of Islamic history describes its significance as the birthplace of Muhammad and the site of the holiest Islamic pilgrimage, the Hajj.

modern_usage.modern_context: Mekka, also known as Makkah, is a city in Saudi Arabia and the holiest city in Islam. Muslims from all over the world travel to Mekka to perform the Islamic pilgrimage, known as Hajj, at least once in their lifetime if they are able to do so. In recent times, Mekka has seen a surge in religious tourism due to the increasing trend of taking spiritual journeys. Social media platforms have become a popular way for pilgrims to share their experiences and photos of the pilgrimage. Travel websites offer travel packages and accommodation booking for those planning to make the journey. Mobile apps provide guidance through the rituals and offer historical and cultural information about the city.
